style: A sheet of sixteen game icons in a strict 4 by 4 grid of equal squares, each icon centred in its own square with clear empty margin around it. Style: hand-carved medieval woodcut print, bold uneven black ink outlines, carved hatching for shade, flat colour laid in by hand from a small palette of ochre, rust red, slate blue, moss green and bone white, slightly off-register like an old printed broadsheet, on plain cream paper. No gradients, no gloss, no glow, no 3D rendering, no photorealism, no frames or borders around the squares, no text, no letters, no numbers. Each icon is one simple bold subject, readable when shrunk very small. Reading left to right, top row first, the sixteen subjects are:
